results.title: HUTCHMED Announces Submission of US NDA for ORPATHYS® plus TAGRISSO® in MET-Driven EGFR-Mutated Lung Cancer
results.description: HUTCHMED announced that AstraZeneca has submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) to the FDA for ORPATHYS® (savolitinib) combined with TAGRISSO® (osimertinib) to treat patients with MET-driven EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer who progressed on EGFR-TKI therapy. The submission is supported by the SAFFRON Phase III trial, which demonstrated statistically significant improvements in progression-free survival and overall survival compared to platinum-based chemotherapy.

results.title: Arvinas Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 1/2 Clinical Trial of ARV-6723, the Company’s First Immuno-Oncology Candidate
results.description: Arvinas announced the first patient dosing in a Phase 1/2 clinical trial of ARV-6723, an oral PROTAC designed to degrade HPK1 for advanced solid tumors. The drug is Arvinas' first immuno-oncology candidate and the first HPK1 PROTAC degrader to enter clinical trials in the US. Preclinical data showed potent HPK1 degradation, enhanced immune activity, and antitumor effects as monotherapy and in combination with anti-PD-1 therapy, including activity in anti-PD-1-resistant models.

results.title: MediciNova Announces Topline Results from  MN-001-NATG-202 Clinical Trial of MN-001 (Tipelukast)
results.description: MediciNova reported topline results from its Phase 2 MN-001-NATG-202 trial evaluating MN-001 (tipelukast) for treating hypertriglyceridemia and NAFLD in type 2 diabetes patients. The drug showed statistically significant increases in HDL-C and HDL-P, significant early triglyceride reduction at Week 4, and numerical improvements in body weight and liver fat. MN-001 demonstrated a favorable safety profile, though the company indicated a larger study is needed to further evaluate efficacy.

results.title: FTAI Acquires 27 Boeing 737-700 Aircraft from WestJet
results.description: FTAI Aviation announced the acquisition of 27 Boeing 737-700 aircraft from WestJet, marking one of its largest aircraft transactions. The deal includes a sale-leaseback of 17 aircraft through FTAI's 2026 SPV (Strategic Capital's second investment vehicle) and the acquisition of 10 off-lease aircraft to support FTAI's Aerospace Products business, expanding its CFM56-7B engine supply.

results.title: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. VI Completes $230,000,000 Initial Public Offering
results.description: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. VI, a blank check company, successfully closed its initial public offering of 23 million units at $10.00 per unit, raising $230 million in gross proceeds. The units began trading on Nasdaq under ticker 'LOVIU' on September 23, 2026. Each unit includes one Class A ordinary share and half a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The company, led by Richard Hendrix and Adam Fishman, will seek to acquire or merge with an operating business.

results.title: Satellos Announces FDA Clearance of IND Application for Forazapadin in Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy (FSHD) and a Partnership with FSHD Canada Foundation Providing Non-Dilutive Financing to Support Clinical Development
results.description: Satellos Bioscience received FDA clearance for its IND application to test forazapadin in facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), expanding the drug candidate into a second degenerative muscle disease. The FSHD Canada Foundation will provide up to US$5 million in non-dilutive financing to support clinical development, with a Phase 2 study expected to begin in Q4 2026. Forazapadin is an AAK1 inhibitor designed to restore muscle repair and regeneration.

results.title: HUTCHMED Highlights Clinical Data to be Presented at the ESMO Congress 2026
results.description: HUTCHMED announced that two Phase III studies evaluating the savolitinib and osimertinib combination for non-small cell lung cancer will be presented at ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid. The SAFFRON global study and SANOVO China study both demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in progression-free survival and overall survival compared to chemotherapy and osimertinib monotherapy, respectively. The all-oral, chemo-free combination has been selected for high-profile oral presentations including a Presidential Symposium.

results.title: Elevar Therapeutics Announces FDA Approval of Lyrfigtu (Lirafugratinib) as Second-line Cholangiocarcinoma with FGFR2 Fusion or Other Rearrangement Treatment Option
results.description: Elevar Therapeutics announced FDA approval of Lyrfigtu (lirafugratinib) for treating cholangiocarcinoma patients with FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement. The drug demonstrated a 46% objective response rate and 11.8-month median duration of response in the Phase 1/2 ReFocus trial. Lyrfigtu is expected to be available in the U.S. by Q4 2026 and represents a second-line treatment option for this rare bile duct cancer.
